reference: I wish I could balance a ball on my head like that.
sk: Škoda, že neviem takto udržať loptu na hlave.
cz: Škoda, že neumím takhle udržet míč na hlavě.
acceptable: I wish I could {balance|keep} {a|the} ball on my head {like that|like this}.
I wish I knew how to {balance|keep} {a|the} ball on my head {like that|like this}.

mistakes.text: I wish I can balance {a|the} ball on my head like that.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “wish” use a past form: “could”, not “can”.

mistakes.text: I wish I could to balance {a|the} ball on my head like that.
mistakes.feedback_en: After “could” use the verb without “to”: “could balance”.

mistakes.text: I wish I couldn't balance {a|the} ball on my head like that.
mistakes.feedback_sk: „Škoda, že neviem“ znamená, že to chceš vedieť: „I wish I could“, bez „not“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: „Škoda, že neumím“ znamená, že to chceš umět: „I wish I could“, bez „not“.
mistakes.feedback_en: “Škoda, že neviem” means you want to be able to: “I wish I could”, without “not”.

mistakes.text: I wish I would balance {a|the} ball on my head like that.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Pri vlastnej schopnosti patrí „I wish I could“, nie „I would“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: U vlastní schopnosti patří „I wish I could“, ne „I would“.
mistakes.feedback_en: For your own ability use “I wish I could”; “I wish I would” doesn't work.

mistakes.text: {It's a pity|It's a shame|Too bad} I can't balance {a|the} ball on my head like that.
mistakes.feedback_sk: Význam sedí, no cvičí sa „wish“: „I wish I could balance…“.
mistakes.feedback_cz: Význam sedí, ale procvičuje se „wish“: „I wish I could balance…“.
mistakes.feedback_en: Same meaning, but this exercise practises “wish”: “I wish I could balance…”.
